name: Support Call
description: The problem, what was tried, the resolution and any follow-up owed to the customer.
outline: Describe the customer's problem in one or two sentences, including product and any error messages mentioned.
List the troubleshooting steps that were tried and what happened for each.
State the resolution, or say clearly that the issue is not resolved.
List follow-up actions owed to the customer or to another team, with owner and timing.
Note the customer's mood at the end only if it was clearly expressed.
Keep it factual: never add information that is not in the transcript, and omit a section when nothing applies.
example:
## Problem
App crashes when exporting to PDF.

## Resolution
Fixed by updating to version 2.4.
